inherited_review.mathematics: The EPS-smoothed effects and denominator match the route. For D=LL†, the bijection ρ ↦ L†ρL/tr(Dρ) yields the implemented Cholesky POVM. Its support in direction w is λmax(ΣᵢwᵢFᵢ); for ‖w‖₂≤1 a positive excess lower-bounds Euclidean distance. The dephased effects use the correct |Uᵢⱼ|² orientation. The √2 Hermitian coordinates, squared spectral Lipschitz constant, eigenvalue simplex projection and FISTA updates agree. Convergence is not required for the support test.
inherited_review.implementation: All 40 queries on each of the six pinned traces are included. Only keys, queries, mask and recorded route probabilities are selected; no gold labels, token text or values are accessed. Native and dephased controls use their respective regions. The linear control is feasible because, for unit keys, its Gram-minus-identity generator induces a unitary query change preserving the denominator. The toy middle-token point mass exceeds the analytic ceiling (1+EPS)/(2+3EPS); the test requires a numerical margin of at least 0.1. Simultaneous counts require both comparisons to pass for the same query.
inherited_review.lifecycle: The prior blocker is resolved: the reviewed design supplies run_path to the expected argv, and a differing --run is rejected before opening canary inputs. The script checks the recipe and expanded command, HEAD and command revision, boot ID, GPU assignment, resources, timeout, max_attempts=1, replay_safe=false and fresh assigned output. It requires a passing both-scope review matching source and design, verifies pinned input hashes, then writes the report and its hash receipt. Scheduler process ownership, cancellation and quiescence remain inherited rather than independently tested.
inherited_review.scope: Static review only; no execution or witness counts asserted. Any separation concerns fixed keys on six one-update technical-canary samples. A missed witness is inconclusive. Neither outcome establishes efficacy, typicality or L5.
risks: The eigenpair residual subtraction and 1e-8 threshold are numerical safeguards, not a rigorous error enclosure for whitening, effect construction and diagonalization. Positive margins are numerical witnesses only.
